item.title: Ainsworth makes first Scotland start as Bonar returns on bench
item.description: Scrum-half Ceitidh Ainsworth will make her first start for Scotland Women, while lock Sarah Bonar makes the match-day squad for the first time since the 2025 Rugby World Cup, for Saturday's visit by New Zealand. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Albanese government considers ‘world-leading’ ban on smart glasses in public offices and buildings
item.description: Minister for public service says the devices pose ‘legitimate privacy and security concerns’ in commonwealth-run workplaces Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Albanese government is considering a “world-leading” ban on smart glasses in its offices and service centres as councils around Australia push the technology out of public spaces over privacy fears. The government has avoided a sweeping ban on the import of the camera-equipped technology and encouraged individual workplaces to set their own rules… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Luca Ittimani

item.title: Smart glasses ban looms as Labor sets out new AI rules
item.description: Smart glasses could be prohibited in Commonwealth workplaces as the government consults on new rules for Australia's growing AI sector. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Clare Armstrong

item.title: New livestream brings remote Australian arid zone waterhole to the world
item.description: A new livestream from a remote waterhole in the Northern Territory is giving people around the world the opportunity to observe wildlife in real time. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: UN-backed experts find US strike on Minab school amounts to war crime
item.description: A fact-finding mission on Iran, backed by the United Nations, finds Iranian citizens have been caught between crimes against humanity by their own government and deadly conflict with the US and Israel. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia cracks down on student and backpacker visas to curb migration
item.description: Under the new measures, a ballot system will be introduced for backpackers seeking to extend their working holiday visas Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Woman arrested after baby found dead in Sydney bin
item.description: NSW Police say a 24-year-old woman "believed to be the mother of the infant" has been arrested. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Man charged with murder after alleged assault in Tasmania's north
item.description: A 42-year-old man has been charged with murder after allegedly assaulting a man at a house in Tasmania's north. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Traumatised Smith says he was 'thrown to wolves' over 'sandpapergate'
item.description: Australia batter Steve Smith says he is still traumatised by the aftermath of the ball-tampering scandal in 2018 and still gets flashbacks. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Backpacker cuts slammed as 'low blow' for farming and tourism
item.description: Farming and tourism industry leaders say cuts to backpacker numbers will slash the available workforce across regional Australia. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chounding and Gian De Poloni

item.title: Disability advocate's tragic drowning spurs life-saving gesture
item.description: Ellen Fraser-Barbour's drowning at a popular swimming hole in central Australia prompts the NT's St John Ambulance service to install an automated external defibrillator at the site to commemorate her disability advocacy work. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emma Haskin

item.title: Grandmother says system failing despite WA child protection minister's flying visit
item.description: On the anniversary of her grandchildren's burial, Dorothy Papertalk is leading calls for change in South Hedland as a political firestorm grows over Western Australia's child protection failures. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Alistair Bates and Amy Rossbach

item.title: NASA scientist's chance Moon discovery reveals once-in-a-lifetime crater
item.description: Wider and about as deep as the Roman Colosseum, researchers believe the newly-discovered McGetchin crater was formed after a powerful surface impact in 2024. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Luke Cooper

item.title: Netballer fined after unprecedented assault charge
item.description: Diamonds defender Sarah Klau is handed a $5,000 fine and a suspended two-game ban after pleading guilty to assault and failing to disclose the incident prior to the Commonwealth Games. But she'll still be eligible to play at the Constellation Cup. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Brittany Carter

item.title: Woman who stabbed sons to death found not criminally responsible
item.description: The woman, who was wiping her eyes in court on Wednesday, will instead be detained at a facility determined by mental health experts. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Digby Werthmuller

item.title: Politician apologises for yelling, swearing in staff meeting
item.description: The commissioner investigating Fiona Carrick's conduct said she had made "well-meaning" but unsuccessful attempts to bring tension down in her office. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Monte Bovill

item.title: 'Alarming': Report says North Korean overseas labour financing nuclear weapons
item.description: Tens of thousands of North Korean labourers working in Russia and China reportedly raised as much as $US800 million last year for Kim Jong Un's nuclear weapons program, helping Pyongyang evade UN sanctions. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Dziedzic

item.title: Court battle looms for Socceroos star after drug test
item.description: Cristian Volpato is set for a court battle as the Socceroos star's lawyer confirms he will challenge charges that he was driving with cocaine in his system. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia makes it harder for foreign students to bring families along
item.description: Home minister says secondary applicants – such as partners and children – will no longer be allowed on most student visas Fuente: The Independent - World.
item.dc:creator: Alisha Rahaman Sarkar

item.title: ACT schools grappling with class 'splitting', as union flags more industrial action
item.description: A nationwide teacher shortage affecting the ACT is causing huge teacher workloads and disrupting learning, as the union calls on the government to step up its pay and conditions offer. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Rojahn, Peter Lusted, and Adam Shirley

item.title: Record jail sentence for Israeli money launderer after Sydney trial
item.description: Shabtay Yaacoby, 56, was sentenced today for laundering more than $50 million in scam funds. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Julian Fell

item.title: With eight words, Tony Burke may have handed his opponents a campaign ad
item.description: It's possible that with eight words about migration, Tony Burke has handed his political opponents a campaign ad — and another reason not to reach a legislative compromise. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Gould

item.title: Police arrest three men in Wadeye over stolen Darwin RAAF base vehicle
item.description: Northern Territory Police have found a Ford Ranger hundreds of kilometres away after it was stolen from a Royal Australian Airforce base in Darwin earlier this week and arrested three men. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Matt Garrick

item.title: Nearly 1,700 sea dragons reported dead during SA's algal bloom
item.description: Dragon Search SA has studied reports of dead sea dragons made during the state's harmful algal bloom amid hopes of boosting numbers as breeding season nears. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Malcolm Sutton

item.title: Australia Post worker stole dozens of bank cards to fund ‘debilitating’ gambling addiction
item.description: Court hears Mauro Paul Coluzzi and two associates defrauded customers and banks of more than $130,000 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast An Australia Post worker’s crippling gambling addiction spiralled into purchases of gold jewellery, phones and even online gaming gift cards with stolen bank cards. Mauro Paul Coluzzi’s family members broke down in court as he was jailed until December 2027 for leading two criminal syndicates funded with pilfered plastic. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Australian Associated Press

item.title: Universities and students alarmed by immigration crackdown on families
item.description: Higher education stakeholders say sweeping migration changes will jeopardise an export industry worth $55 billion, with international students likely to choose other destinations. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Mikaela Ortolan and Max Walden

item.title: Sydney duo finishes 9 gigs in 12 hours after helicopter, plane delays, with 15 seconds left
item.description: Sydney dream pop duo Fathom attempted a Guinness World Records title by performing nine 15-minute gigs across NSW and Canberra within 12 hours. Their journey faced delays after a firefighting helicopter was unavailable and a plane’s propeller failed. Despite falling an hour behind schedule, Cate Guirguis and Jaxon Italiano completed their final Canberra show with just 15 seconds to spare. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Man accused of attacking two boys had 40 police 'involvements', court hears
item.description: Prosecutors said those interactions included a string of incidents in which the man was accused of assaulting young children and threatening staff at a primary school. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Harry Frost

item.title: Reza Pahlavi accepts Coalition invitation to visit Australia
item.description: The exiled son of Iran's last shah says he wants to be a "bridge" to democracy in Iran, not a candidate to lead the country. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Oscar Coleman

item.title: Coal-fired power needed to bolster $32bn Qld data centre, Nationals MP says
item.description: Nationals MP David Littleproud is backing more coal-fired power stations and nuclear energy to underpin the enormous energy requirements of a $32bn data centre. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Clarke and Liz Gwynn

item.title: Teen's murder case delayed after NT's forensic pathologist takes leave
item.description: A 17-year-old boy charged with murdering a man in Tennant Creek in June will have to wait another three months for a crucial piece of evidence after a key witness went on leave, a court has heard. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Elsie Lange

item.title: Woman, 28, found dead hours after alleged domestic violence assault
item.description: A young woman has been found dead at a property in suburban Darwin, with her partner in custody over an alleged assault hours earlier. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Matt Garrick

item.title: Remote waterhole live stream a window into secrets of NT desert
item.description: A camera streaming around the clock from a remote Central Australian waterhole is capturing dingoes, wallabies, birds and other wildlife while helping researchers understand how the changing climate is reshaping the desert. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Labor unveils migration cuts targeting students, backpackers and overstayers
item.description: Labor will restrict international student families, cap longer backpacker stays and target visa overstayers as it seeks greater control over migration. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
